messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Our records show 14.0 hours unposted for the week ending 13 February. Please post your time by 17:00 Wednesday so we can run the month-end WIP report. Matters with significant unbilled WIP this month include several in the Employment and Corporate teams.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
